title: Stop looking in the rearview mirror at the wreckage of your yesterday. You aren’t going that way. 👉
paragraphs: Stop looking in the rearview mirror at the wreckage of your yesterday. You aren’t going that way. 👉

If you’re reading this, God is trying to tell you that your history does not determine your destiny. The same GRACE that pulled you out of the storm is the exact same POWER that will lead you into your new season. The road ahead is brighter than anything you’ve left behind.
Don’t let the shadows of your past block the light of your future.

📖 “Forget the former things; do not dwell on the past. See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it? I am making a way in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland.” — Isaiah 43:18-19
🔥 Type "I AM MOVING FORWARD" if you are ready for your next chapter!
👇 Follow me for daily faith and motivation to keep going. 👇
